idealClarificationQuestions: Dark store catchment radius for 10-min: ~1.5-2 km? Yes.
Current Zepto coverage or full citywide? Full citywide.

calculationFlow: Bengaluru metropolitan area: ~750 sq km (urban + suburban).
Each dark store catchment (1.8 km radius circle): π × 1.8^2 ≈ 10 sq km.
Theoretical dark stores for full coverage: 750 / 10 = ~75 stores.
But quick commerce concentrates in ~60% of city (high-density residential + commercial); ~450 sq km serviceable = ~45 stores at full coverage.

Each store needs minimum order density to be viable: ~1,000-1,500 orders/day. Bengaluru Zepto orders ~250K/day (assuming 25% market share of ~1M Bengaluru quick commerce). 250K / 45 stores = ~5,500 orders/store/day — well above viability.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Zepto needs ~40-50 dark stores in Bengaluru for full 10-min coverage.
